$comment: Times are UTC. d1 = the first day of public posting (after the 24 h dry run is signed off). launchAt = the ANNOUNCED launch time — stays null until the owner confirms it; it must be ≥ 26 h away so the announcement (slot T-26h) goes out ≥ 24 h before the mint. launchedAt = the REAL launch minute, set automatically when the mint is verified on-chain; every T+ post counts from it. Recompute with: node scripts/schedule.mjs
why: Proposal only — the owner decides. 15:00 UTC = 11:00 New York, 17:00 Berlin, 23:00 Singapore.
